newsitem.title: UK: RMC says results higher, warns on sterling.
newsitem.headline: RMC says results higher, warns on sterling.

text.p: British construction industry supplier RMC Group Plc said on Friday it had made a reasonable start to the year but warned the strong pound would offset some of the underlying improvement in first-half earnings.

"Although the markets in Germany and some other continental European countries remain subdued, our particular market positions and our lower cost structures have enabled us to improve results to date," chairman Christopher Hampson said in a statement.
"The strength of sterling will have an impact on the translation of the group's overseas results and this will offset some of the underlying improvement in earnings in the first half," Hampson added.
Hampson said RMC had been helped because the weather this year had not been as poor as last year.
He said market conditions in Britain were improving and business in the U.S., Ireland and Israel continued to perform strongly.
RMC shares were down 2-1/2p or 0.3 percent in London at 910p, while the broader market was down 0.73 percent.
